blocks.text: Cells ki daryaft (discovery) aur phir cell ke andar ki banawat (internal structure) ki mazeed studies microscope ke istemal par hi mumkin hui. Microscopy woh technique hai jis mein microscope se aisi cheezen dekhi aur parhi jati hain jo itni chhoti hain ke nangi aankh (naked eye) se nazar nahi aatin. Microscopes lenses aur light ya electron beams se specimens (namoone) ko bara (magnify) aur roshan (illuminate) karte hain.

blocks.title: Magnification and Resolution
blocks.text:
Yeh microscope ki do sab se aham khususiyat (characteristics) hain.
Magnification: microscope ki woh salahiyat (ability) jis se woh cheez ka image bara kar deta hai. Har lens ki magnification alag hoti hai. Ise 'X' se likhte hain, jo batata hai ke image asal size se kitne guna bara nazar aata hai. Misal: 10X lens 1 µm ki cheez ko 10 µm jitna bara dikhata hai. Microscope ki kul (total) magnification tamam lenses ki magnification ko aapas mein zarb (multiply) kar ke milti hai.
Resolution: microscope ki woh salahiyat jis se woh kisi cheez par bohat qareeb do nuqton ko alag alag dikha sake. Resolution jitni zyada ho, utni bareek detail nazar aati hai. Insani aankh ki resolution taqreeban 0.1 mm hai, jabke light microscope taqreeban 250 nm (nanometres) tak ki detail alag dikha sakta hai.

Light microscope mein cheez ka image banane ke liye light (roshni) istemal hoti hai. Light pehle cheez mein se aur phir sheeshe ke do lenses mein se guzarti hai. Ek lens cheez ka bara image banata hai aur doosra lens us image ko aur bara kar deta hai. Is tarah dekhne wale ki aankh mein cheez ka bara aur saaf image banta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Compound light microscope jis ke hisse label hain: eyepiece (ocular lens), arm, nosepiece, objective lens, stage par specimen, diaphragm, coarse adjustment, fine adjustment, light source aur base. (b) Kaam ka usool: light source ki roshni condenser, specimen, objective lens aur ocular lens se guzar kar dekhne wale (viewer) ki aankh tak pohanchti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2: (a) Light microscope ke bare hisse; (b) Light microscope ke kaam ka usool (textbook ki Figure 3.2 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Roshni neeche se oopar jati hai: light source, phir condenser (roshni ko specimen par jama karta hai), phir specimen, phir objective lens (pehli bari image), aur aakhir mein ocular lens (image ko mazeed bara karta hai). Coarse aur fine adjustment se focus theek hota hai.

Light microscope ki magnification 1500X hai, yani yeh cheezon ko taqreeban 1500 guna bara kar sakta hai. Is ki resolving power (do qareeb nuqton ko alag dikhane ki had) 0.2 micrometre (µm) hai, aur 1 µm = 1/1000 mm. Yani light microscope 0.2 µm se chhoti cheezon ko alag alag nahi dikha sakta.

Light microscope zinda jandaron ko dekhne ke liye faida-mand hai. Lekin cells aam taur par transparent (shaffaf, aar-paar dikhne wale) hote hain, is liye un ke hisse tab tak alag nazar nahi aate jab tak unhen khaas stains (rang dene wale chemicals) se rang na diya jaye. Masla yeh hai ke staining aam taur par cells ko maar deti hai.

Electron microscope mein electrons ka beam (dhaara) cheez mein se guzarta hai. Magnetic lenses is beam ko screen ya photographic film par focus karte hain aur bohat bara image banate hain. Is ki resolving power light microscope se bohat zyada hai: yeh 0.2 nanometre (nm) jitni chhoti cheez bhi saaf dikha deta hai, aur 1 nm = 1/1000,000 mm (millimetre ka das lakhwan hissa). Lekin electron microscope se zinda cheez nahi dekhi ja sakti, kyun ke specimen tayyar karne ke tareeqe cell ko zinda nahi rehne dete. Biologists do qisam ke electron microscopes istemal karte hain.

Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) cell ki andar ki banawat dekhne ke liye hai. TEM electrons ka beam bohat patle specimen ke aar-paar guzarta hai. Yeh cheezon ko 250,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai. Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) cells ya kisi bhi cheez ki surface (satah) ki detail dekhne ke liye hai. Surface par metal ki tah chadhai jati hai. Jab electron beam metal se takrata hai to woh reflect (palat) ho kar bara image banata hai. SEM cheezon ko 100,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Scanning electron microscope: oopar electron source, phir condenser lenses, aperture, scanning coil aur objective lens bareek beam ko sample par dalte hain; back-scattered electron detector aur secondary electron detector sample se aane wale electrons pakarte hain, aur signal amplifier se computer screen tak jata hai; scan generator beam ko chalata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: (a) Scanning electron microscope aur (b) Transmission electron microscope ke kaam ka usool (textbook ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: (a) Scanning electron microscope: oopar electron source, phir condenser lenses, aperture, scanning coil aur objective lens bareek beam ko sample par dalte hain; back-scattered electron detector aur secondary electron detector sample se aane wale electrons pakarte hain, aur signal amplifier se computer screen tak jata hai; scan generator beam ko chalata hai. (b) Transmission electron microscope: electron source, condenser lenses, condenser aperture, sample, objective lens, objective aperture, intermediate lenses, projective lens, aur neeche fluorescent screen aur camera.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: TEM mein electrons patle sample ke aar-paar (transmit) jate hain, is liye andaruni banawat nazar aati hai aur image neeche screen par banti hai. SEM mein beam sample ki satah par phirai jati hai (scan), aur satah se uchhalne wale electrons detectors pakarte hain; is liye satah ki 3D jaisi tasveer milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm kehta hai ke 100X objective aur 15X eyepiece wala light microscope 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqton ko alag-alag dikhayega. Is dawe mein kya ghalat hai?
blocks.explanation: Kul magnification 100 × 15 = 1500X hai, jo light microscope ki had hai, magar magnification resolution nahin hai. Light microscope taqreeban 0.2 µm se qareeb kuch resolve nahin kar sakta, is liye 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqte chahe kitne bhi bare kiye jayen ek mein mil jayenge. Electron microscope, jo 0.2 nm resolve karta hai, unhen alag kar sakta hai.

items: Magnification yeh hai ke image kitne guna bara hai (lenses zarb hote hain); resolution woh sab se chhota fasla hai jo do nuqton ke taur par dekha ja sake.
Light microscope: roshni aur sheeshe ke lenses; 1500X tak; 0.2 µm resolve karta hai; zinda ya stained namoone, magar staining aam taur par cells maar deti hai.
Electron microscope: electron beam aur magnetic lenses; 0.2 nm resolve karta hai; murda, khaas tayyar-shuda namoone. TEM andaruni banawat dikhata hai (250,000X); SEM satah dikhata hai (100,000X).
